subject: Taxes
title: What Is Corporate Tax?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Is Corporate Tax?.

hook.text: Corporate tax takes a percentage of a company's profits. In the US, the federal rate is 21%.

buildup.text: Corporate tax applies to profits, not revenue. A $10B revenue company might have just $2 billion in taxable profit.

discovery.text: Corporate tax generates about 9% of federal revenue—far less than individual income tax. It once provided over 30%.

twist.text: In 2020, 55 of the largest US corporations paid zero federal income tax despite earning $40 billion in combined profits.

climax.text: The gap between the statutory rate and the effective rate is the entire story of corporate taxation.

punchline.text: 21% rate, 0% paid by 55 major companies. The gap is the story.

quiz.question: What share of federal revenue does corporate tax currently provide?
